paragraphs.source_zh: 二人在松树下你来我往，一场恶斗，最终，山路将监的首级被加藤虎之助砍落。

paragraphs.source_en: The brilliant morning sun rose and shone upon the tender green leaves. A fresh breeze stirred, and sunlight sparkled upon Lake Yogo. Everything was beautiful; only men continued their brutal struggle, enacting one tragedy after another in a hell on earth. From slopes to valleys, from roads to thickets, dark-red blood flowed everywhere.

units.source_en: The brilliant morning sun rose and shone upon the tender green leaves.
units.source_zh: 灿烂的朝阳升起来了，照射着嫩绿的树叶。

units.source_en: A fresh breeze stirred, and sunlight sparkled upon Lake Yogo.
units.source_zh: 清风徐来，余吴湖的湖面波光粼粼。

units.source_en: Everything was beautiful; only men continued their brutal struggle, enacting one tragedy after another in a hell on earth.
units.source_zh: 一切都那么美好，只有人还在残忍地打斗，还在上演着一场场人间地狱的悲剧。

units.source_en: From slopes to valleys, from roads to thickets, dark-red blood flowed everywhere.
units.source_zh: 从山坡到山谷，从道路到草丛，到处都淌着殷红的鲜血。

paragraphs.source_zh: 灿烂的朝阳升起来了，照射着嫩绿的树叶。清风徐来，余吴湖的湖面波光粼粼。一切都那么美好，只有人还在残忍地打斗，还在上演着一场场人间地狱的悲剧。从山坡到山谷，从道路到草丛，到处都淌着殷红的鲜血。

paragraphs.source_en: Upon withdrawing to the vicinity of Gengenzaka, Sakuma Genba Morimasa finally breathed a sigh of relief; before long he would be able to retreat to Mount Gyōichi. Morimasa intended, once he had withdrawn, to join forces with his own brother Katsumasa and then seek a chance to strike back. But just as the order to withdraw reached Katsumasa and he prepared to retreat, the situation changed without warning.

units.source_en: Upon withdrawing to the vicinity of Gengenzaka, Sakuma Genba Morimasa finally breathed a sigh of relief; before long he would be able to retreat to Mount Gyōichi.
units.source_zh: 当撤退到权现坂附近，佐久间玄蕃盛政终于舒了一口气，不时就可以撤回行市山了。

units.source_en: Morimasa intended, once he had withdrawn, to join forces with his own brother Katsumasa and then seek a chance to strike back.

ja.t: をうかがうつもりだった。

units.source_zh: 盛政打算撤回之后，和亲兄弟胜政合兵一处，再谋求反戈一击。

units.source_en: But just as the order to withdraw reached Katsumasa and he prepared to retreat, the situation changed without warning.
units.source_zh: 当撤军的命令传达给胜政，胜政正准备撤退之时，不料风云突变。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当撤退到权现坂附近，佐久间玄蕃盛政终于舒了一口气，不时就可以撤回行市山了。盛政打算撤回之后，和亲兄弟胜政合兵一处，再谋求反戈一击。当撤军的命令传达给胜政，胜政正准备撤退之时，不料风云突变。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi, who had been poised to strike, sounded the attack at precisely the right moment. Countless guns roared at once, and a vast host charged like tigers descending a mountain, cutting the enemy formation into several sections in the blink of an eye.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi, who had been poised to strike, sounded the attack at precisely the right moment. Countless guns roared at once, and a vast host charged like tigers descending a mountain, cutting the enemy formation into several sections in the blink of an eye.
units.source_zh: 此前一直蓄势待发的秀吉及时吹响了进攻的号角，顿时万枪齐发，千军万马像下山猛虎般冲向敌人，眨眼间就把敌军的队伍截成了几段。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此前一直蓄势待发的秀吉及时吹响了进攻的号角，顿时万枪齐发，千军万马像下山猛虎般冲向敌人，眨眼间就把敌军的队伍截成了几段。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsumasa’s troops had fought bitterly since the previous day and had also borne the duty of covering Morimasa; the whole army was exhausted beyond measure when, at the very moment it resolved to withdraw, it came under sudden attack. For a time the samurai managed to offer some resistance, but the common foot soldiers had already lost the will to fight.

units.source_en: Katsumasa’s troops had fought bitterly since the previous day and had also borne the duty of covering Morimasa; the whole army was exhausted beyond measure when, at the very moment it resolved to withdraw, it came under sudden attack.
units.source_zh: 胜政的军队从昨日起就一直苦战，还担负了掩护盛政的任务，全军上下都已经疲惫到了极点，在决定撤军之时，却突然遭受袭击。

units.source_en: For a time the samurai managed to offer some resistance, but the common foot soldiers had already lost the will to fight.
units.source_zh: 一时间，武士们倒还可以勉强应战，杂兵们可早就丧失了斗志。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜政的军队从昨日起就一直苦战，还担负了掩护盛政的任务，全军上下都已经疲惫到了极点，在决定撤军之时，却突然遭受袭击。一时间，武士们倒还可以勉强应战，杂兵们可早就丧失了斗志。

paragraphs.source_en: Had Morimasa known that he had fallen squarely into Hideyoshi’s trap, he would surely have ground his teeth in fury.

units.source_en: Had Morimasa known that he had fallen squarely into Hideyoshi’s trap, he would surely have ground his teeth in fury.

ja.t: にまんまとはまったと
ぎしりしたことだろう。

units.source_zh: 若盛政知道正中秀吉的圈套，定会恨得咬牙切齿。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若盛政知道正中秀吉的圈套，定会恨得咬牙切齿。

paragraphs.source_en: By the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Dragon, the mist among the trees and valleys had dispersed.

units.source_en: By the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Dragon, the mist among the trees and valleys had dispersed.
units.source_zh: 辰时四刻，树丛和山谷里的雾已然散去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 辰时四刻，树丛和山谷里的雾已然散去。

paragraphs.source_en: Reports arrived one after another, but every one brought grim news of another commander slain on their side.

units.source_en: Reports arrived one after another, but every one brought grim news of another commander slain on their side.
units.source_zh: 消息不断传来，可是全都是己方大将战死的噩耗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 消息不断传来，可是全都是己方大将战死的噩耗。

paragraphs.source_en: “A report!” A close retainer hurried in, visibly flustered.

units.source_en: “A report!”
A close retainer hurried in, visibly flustered.
units.source_zh: 一个近侍慌慌张张地前来报告。

paragraphs.source_zh: “报。”一个近侍慌慌张张地前来报告。

paragraphs.source_en: “Who has fallen?”

units.source_en: “Who has fallen?”
units.source_zh: “有什么人战死？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “有什么人战死？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No—disaster has struck. Maeda Toshiie and his son, who were stationed on Mount Shige, have abandoned their position and begun moving in the direction of our retreat.”

units.source_en: “No—disaster has struck.
units.source_zh: “不，大事不好。

units.source_en: Maeda Toshiie and his son, who were stationed on Mount Shige, have abandoned their position and begun moving in the direction of our retreat.”
units.source_zh: 原驻扎在茂山的前田利家父子舍弃了阵地，开始向我军撤退的方向移动。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，大事不好。原驻扎在茂山的前田利家父子舍弃了阵地，开始向我军撤退的方向移动。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Maeda Toshiie and his son… Is that not treachery?”

units.source_en: “Maeda Toshiie and his son… Is that not treachery?”
units.source_zh: “前田利家父子……这不是叛变吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “前田利家父子……这不是叛变吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. Precisely so.”

units.source_en: “Yes. Precisely so.”

ja.t: 「はっ、そのとおりでございます」

units.source_zh: “是，正是。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是，正是。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Nonsense! How can that be? How could the Maedas…” Morimasa hurried out of the command tent and looked. Sure enough, just as the guard had said, the Maeda troops had descended Mount Shige and were moving north.

units.source_en: “Nonsense!
units.source_zh: “胡说！

units.source_en: How can that be?

ja.t: そんなはずがあるものか！

units.source_zh: 这怎么可能！

units.source_en: How could the Maedas…” Morimasa hurried out of the command tent and looked. Sure enough, just as the guard had said, the Maeda troops had descended Mount Shige and were moving north.
units.source_zh: 前田父子怎么会……”说着，盛政慌忙跑出大帐一看，果然如侍卫所说，前田的人马已经下了茂山，正在向北面移动。

paragraphs.source_zh: “胡说！这怎么可能！前田父子怎么会……”说着，盛政慌忙跑出大帐一看，果然如侍卫所说，前田的人马已经下了茂山，正在向北面移动。

paragraphs.source_en: “Kuw山?重晴 and Niwa’s troops have descended from the stronghold on Shizugatake and joined the pursuit.”

units.source_en: “Kuw山?重晴 and Niwa’s troops have descended from the stronghold on Shizugatake and joined the pursuit.”
units.source_zh: “桑山重晴和丹羽的军队已经从贱岳的要塞上下来，也加入了追击之列。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “桑山重晴和丹羽的军队已经从贱岳的要塞上下来，也加入了追击之列。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Another three thousand fresh troops are pursuing us.”

units.source_en: “Another three thousand fresh troops are pursuing us.”
units.source_zh: “又有三千新的兵力来追击我们。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “又有三千新的兵力来追击我们。”

paragraphs.source_en: “The enemy on Mount Shinmei has come out in full force and means to cut off our rearward route.”

units.source_en: “The enemy on Mount Shinmei has come out in full force and means to cut off our rearward route.”
units.source_zh: “神明山的敌人已经倾巢出动，欲切断我军后路。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “神明山的敌人已经倾巢出动，欲切断我军后路。”

paragraphs.source_en: Urgent reports arrived one after another. Sakuma Morimasa said nothing, then suddenly threw back his head and laughed.

units.source_en: Urgent reports arrived one after another. Sakuma Morimasa said nothing, then suddenly threw back his head and laughed.
units.source_zh: 急报一道道传来，佐久间盛政一言不发，突然仰天大笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 急报一道道传来，佐久间盛政一言不发，突然仰天大笑。

paragraphs.source_en: Looking back, the Maeda troops had seemed unwilling to fight from the very beginning. Although Maeda Toshiie and his son obeyed Shibata Katsuie, their affection for Hideyoshi ran deeper. If that were true, Toshiie would surely not sacrifice a single soldier for either side. He would certainly withdraw to Echizen before victory or defeat was decided, then seek some means of dealing with the aftermath.

units.source_en: Looking back, the Maeda troops had seemed unwilling to fight from the very beginning.
units.source_zh: 回想起来，前田的军队从一开始就似无战意。

units.source_en: Although Maeda Toshiie and his son obeyed Shibata Katsuie, their affection for Hideyoshi ran deeper.
units.source_zh: 前田父子虽听命于柴田胜家，对秀吉却怀有更深厚的感情。

units.source_en: If that were true, Toshiie would surely not sacrifice a single soldier for either side.

ja.t: おうとはしないはずだ。

units.source_zh: 若真如此，他定不会为任何一方损失一兵一卒。

units.source_en: He would certainly withdraw to Echizen before victory or defeat was decided, then seek some means of dealing with the aftermath.
units.source_zh: 他必定在胜负决出之前先撤回越前，再谋求善后之策。

paragraphs.source_zh: 回想起来，前田的军队从一开始就似无战意。前田父子虽听命于柴田胜家，对秀吉却怀有更深厚的感情。若真如此，他定不会为任何一方损失一兵一卒。他必定在胜负决出之前先撤回越前，再谋求善后之策。

paragraphs.source_en: Moreover, Hideyoshi’s forces were sweeping down from Mount Shinmei in one fierce rush, threatening to sever Sakuma’s route of retreat. Maeda Toshiie and his son had not struck Morimasa from behind, but for Hideyoshi that was already enough: he had profited from their action, which was scarcely different from outright betrayal.

units.source_en: Moreover, Hideyoshi’s forces were sweeping down from Mount Shinmei in one fierce rush, threatening to sever Sakuma’s route of retreat.
units.source_zh: 而且，秀吉的军队正从神明山上一口气掩杀过来，大有掐断佐久间退路之势。

units.source_en: Maeda Toshiie and his son had not struck Morimasa from behind, but for Hideyoshi that was already enough: he had profited from their action, which was scarcely different from outright betrayal.

ja.t: したわけではない。それでも

units.source_zh: 尽管前田利家父子没有从背后对盛政一击，可是，对秀吉而言，这已经足够了，他已从中获益——前田的行为跟叛变简直没有两样。

paragraphs.source_zh: 而且，秀吉的军队正从神明山上一口气掩杀过来，大有掐断佐久间退路之势。尽管前田利家父子没有从背后对盛政一击，可是，对秀吉而言，这已经足够了，他已从中获益——前田的行为跟叛变简直没有两样。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, it is dangerous here! The enemy is bearing down on us from three directions with irresistible force.”

units.source_en: “My lord, it is dangerous here!
units.source_zh: “大人，这里危险！

units.source_en: The enemy is bearing down on us from three directions with irresistible force.”
units.source_zh: 敌人正以破竹之势，从三个方向向我军压来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人，这里危险！敌人正以破竹之势，从三个方向向我军压来。”

paragraphs.source_en: With that, the entire Sakuma army collapsed completely. Some continued to follow Morimasa; some slipped into the Maeda ranks and quietly fled; others hid in the valleys; and some even rolled up their great banners and surrendered to the enemy on the spot.

units.source_en: With that, the entire Sakuma army collapsed completely.
units.source_zh: 这样一来，整个佐久间的军队就完全崩溃了。

units.source_en: Some continued to follow Morimasa; some slipped into the Maeda ranks and quietly fled; others hid in the valleys; and some even rolled up their great banners and surrendered to the enemy on the spot.
units.source_zh: 有的继续跟在盛政身后，有的则混进前田的军队悄悄地逃跑了，还有的藏到了山谷里，更有甚者，干脆把大旗一卷，就地降了敌人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样一来，整个佐久间的军队就完全崩溃了。有的继续跟在盛政身后，有的则混进前田的军队悄悄地逃跑了，还有的藏到了山谷里，更有甚者，干脆把大旗一卷，就地降了敌人。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Hideyoshi’s mighty cavalry, facing the brilliant sun, surged northward like raging waves. How long would this glorious advance continue? Perhaps he would maintain this overwhelming momentum and sweep all the way into Echizen without pause.

units.source_en: Before long, Hideyoshi’s mighty cavalry, facing the brilliant sun, surged northward like raging waves.
units.source_zh: 不久，秀吉威武的马队迎着灿烂的太阳，像怒涛一般扑向了北方。

units.source_en: How long would this glorious advance continue?
units.source_zh: 这样辉煌的进击，究竟要持续到何时呢？

units.source_en: Perhaps he would maintain this overwhelming momentum and sweep all the way into Echizen without pause.
units.source_zh: 或许，他会一直像眼前这般，以排山倒海之势，一口气杀到越前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，秀吉威武的马队迎着灿烂的太阳，像怒涛一般扑向了北方。这样辉煌的进击，究竟要持续到何时呢？或许，他会一直像眼前这般，以排山倒海之势，一口气杀到越前。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet after all the forces converged on Mount Fumuro, seized it in a single charge, and drove the enemy from its heights, Hideyoshi—who had pursued without respite as far as Shūfukujizaka—suddenly ordered his troops to halt the chase.

units.source_en: Yet after all the forces converged on Mount Fumuro, seized it in a single charge, and drove the enemy from its heights, Hideyoshi—who had pursued without respite as far as Shūfukujizaka—suddenly ordered his troops to halt the chase.
units.source_zh: 可是，当所有的军队都汇集到文室山，一鼓作气拿下此山，并把山上的敌人赶下去时，一路马不停蹄追赶到集福寺坂的秀吉，却突然命令部队停止追击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 可是，当所有的军队都汇集到文室山，一鼓作气拿下此山，并把山上的敌人赶下去时，一路马不停蹄追赶到集福寺坂的秀吉，却突然命令部队停止追击。

paragraphs.source_en: As noon approached, Hideyoshi halted on a small hill at the foot of Mount Fumuro. “That will do. Everyone, take a good rest and prepare to eat!”

units.source_en: As noon approached, Hideyoshi halted on a small hill at the foot of Mount Fumuro.
units.source_zh: 时近正午，秀吉在文室山麓的一个小山丘停了下来。

units.source_en: “That will do. Everyone, take a good rest and prepare to eat!”
units.source_zh: “好了，大家好好歇息一下，准备开饭！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 时近正午，秀吉在文室山麓的一个小山丘停了下来。“好了，大家好好歇息一下，准备开饭！”
